about_the_game:
Failed the civil service exam, but unexpectedly transmigrated to another world!
The divine blessing promised by the gods turns out to be just the ability to identify herbs?

Players will freely explore the otherworld, trade, complete bounties, and build relationships with various girls. By chance, they manage to create powerful potions during exploration! From then on, teammates become lovers, and the cold goddess turns into an obsessed fangirl~

As players complete tasks and earn money through trade, they can upgrade their pharmacy to gain more potion crafting bonuses. Players can also choose to upgrade their caravan to increase carrying capacity and engage in more trade, using money to make more money!

Heroines
There are two heroines to romance: adventurer catgirl Mina, and magic academy top student Elina. Players can increase affection through story progression and gift-giving, unlocking lewd CGs, shared sleeping, and commission features.

Trade
Players can travel between five cities in the game to trade. Each city has unique specialties, and choosing the most profitable trade goods is the key to riches!

Potion Crafting
Players can gather or purchase potion ingredients in different cities and craft various potions in their own shop. Each potion has a different effect—some with magical surprises!

content_descriptors.notes:
成人内容警告
本游戏并非面向所有年龄段，仅适合成年人。游戏包含裸露画面、性爱动作、 配音中强烈的性暗示以及露骨的性爱音效。所有角色均为虚构成人。 游戏内容涵盖恋爱追求、后宫发展以及超自然性支配，玩家可根据个人喜好 和舒适度自由选择体验。请在游戏过程中遵守您所在地的法律法规，并享受 丰富多样的互动内容。
